# FoodFlow Core — White-Label Restaurant Ordering Documentation

> FoodFlow Core is a high-performance, white-label food ordering platform and WhatsApp checkout starter kit built with React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Vite 6, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Core Documentation & Resources
- [Online Store & Interactive Menu](https://foodflow-core.pages.dev/)
- [Menu Categories & Catalog](https://foodflow-core.pages.dev/categories)
- [Admin Backoffice Panel](https://foodflow-core.pages.dev/admin/login)
- [Repository & Source](https://github.com/soycheppi/foodflow-core)
